verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions independent or third-party security audits of the Ente Auth app or its sync protocol. The pack documents end-to-end encrypted sync, the key-derivation parameters of the export format, and that the apps and server are open source. Those are adjacent transparency signals, not published independent audits, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
